question.text: A transverse sinusoidal wave moves along a string in the positive $x$-direction at a speed of $10 \mathrm{~cm} / \mathrm{s}$. The wavelength of the wave is $0.5 \mathrm{~m}$ and its amplitude is $10 \mathrm{~cm}$. At a particular time $t$, the snap-shot of the wave is shown in figure. The velocity of point $P$ when its displacement is $5 \mathrm{~cm}$ is

solution.text:
Particle velocity $v_p=-v$ (slope of $y-x$ graph)
Here,$v=+v e$, as the wave is travelling in positive $x$-direction.
Slope at $P$ is negative.
$\therefore$ Velocity of particle is in positive $y(+\overrightarrow{\mathbf{j}})$ direction.
$\therefore$ correct option is (a).
